mapper.insert: INSERT INTO meetings ( host_user_id, title, status, desired_end_at, calculation_version, invite_code ) VALUES ( #{hostUserId}, #{title}, #{status}, #{desiredEndAt}, #{calculationVersion}, #{inviteCode} )
mapper.select: SELECT meeting_id, host_user_id, title, status, desired_end_at, calculation_version, invite_code, final_candidate_id, created_at, updated_at FROM meetings WHERE meeting_id = #{meetingId}
